items.headline: U.S.-Canada Trade Dispute Escalates as Trump Threatens 50% Auto Tariffs
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump announced new 50% tariffs on Canadian automobiles, auto parts, and steel following the collapse of bilateral trade negotiations. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney rejected Washington's demands as a threat to national sovereignty, confirming that Canada will launch dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs on American goods in September.
